The '''543th Denbari Attack Company''' was a unit of the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Army]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The notable [[Company/Legends|company]],<ref name="HR" /> which shared its name with the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim's]] [[Denbar system/Legends|Denbar system]],<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref> carried out special operations and repeatedly distinguished itself.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 543th Denbari Attack Company was mentioned in the [[1995]] sourcebook ''[[Heroes & Rogues]]'', authored by [[Rick D. Stuart|Rick Stuart]] and [[Paul Sudlow]] and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''. The book gives the company as an example of a special operations unit that player characters in a Galactic Empire [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] campaign can be assigned to based on their record of renowned deeds, noting that serving with the unit would lead to the characters experiencing a lot of action.<ref name="HR" />
